tasks.label: hybrid-rag: MCP server (stdio)
tasks.detail: Level 0 only. None of its three tools can spend cloud tokens.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: MCP server (HTTP :8765)
tasks.detail: Same tools over streamable HTTP, for clients that cannot spawn stdio.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: doctor (VRAM co-residency)
tasks.detail: Expect ollama up, keep_alive -1, and the resolved generator profile.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: ollama ps (expect ~4.1 GB, 100% GPU)
tasks.detail: Three entries totalling ~4.1 GB. A CPU split means the set spilled out of VRAM.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: eval harness tests (offline)
tasks.detail: No Ollama, no index, no network.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: full gate (ruff + mypy + pytest)
tasks.command: uv run ruff check src tests && uv run mypy && uv run pytest
tasks.detail: Everything docs/VERIFY.md requires before calling work done.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: recalibrate thresholds
tasks.detail: Mandatory after any reranker or embedder change. Needs data/calibration.

tasks.label: hybrid-rag: setup .env
tasks.detail: Creates a gitignored .env from the example. Never overwrites an existing one.
